# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1666
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1666
- **Title**: gh-1659 [GOAL] Fold the Office add-in check into the shared CI matrix (office-addin.yml runs standalone per PR today)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1659` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +467
- **Deletions**: -33
- **Created**: 2026-10-17T08:03:10Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-17T11:06:50Z

## PR Description

Closes #1659
### What changed
Folded the Office add-in acceptance suite into `ci.yml` as a path-gated `office-addin-suite` job and retired `office-addin.yml`'s `push`/`pull_request` triggers — a PR now gets ONE workflow entry. The dispatch-only daily-publish leg still fires `office-addin.yml` directly.

### Key decisions
- New `changes` classifier output `office_addin` carries the EXACT path list the retired standalone triggers used (`office_addin/**`, `flutter_app/**`, `packages/**`, `lib/**`, `pubspec.lock`, `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`, `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml`); gated on `pull_request` + SM validation dispatches like exzone/locksmoke, and the classifier's fail-safe arm runs it rather than silently skipping.
- Job body byte-identical to the daily leg's (drift-guard test pins the two copies) — no behavior change; runner/timeout (`ubuntu-latest`, 45m, `contents: read`) unchanged.
- Wired into `quality-gate` as a PLATFORM-class leg (#1368): a red suite blocks the merge via the aggregate but never holds the pure-Dart publish; non-touching PRs skip exactly as today.
- **Check name for the ruleset update (AC3):** the check-run name is unchanged — `Office add-in suite` (branch protection / ruleset contexts that match the bare job name keep working). Only the display prefix changes: `Office add-in / office-addin-suite` → `CI / office-addin-suite`. Update the ruleset ONLY if it pinned the composite form.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart
```
Manual: a `lib/**`-only PR shows one workflow (CI) with the office-addin job inside; a `docs/**`-only PR skips it; `workflow_dispatch` on `office-addin.yml` still serves the daily addin leg.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  PR[PR touches lib / flutter_app / packages / office_addin] --> CL[ci.yml changes classifier]
  CL -->|office_addin=true| JOB[office-addin-suite job in ci.yml]
  JOB --> QG[quality-gate — platform class, single required check]
  DAILY[daily-publish addin leg] -->|workflow_dispatch| OA[office-addin.yml — dispatch only]
```

</details>

      # PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit

      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1666
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1666
- **Title**: gh-1659 [GOAL] Fold the Office add-in check into the shared CI matrix (office-addin.yml runs standalone per PR today)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1659` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +467
- **Deletions**: -33
- **Created**: 2026-10-17T08:03:10Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-17T11:06:50Z

## PR Description

Closes #1659
### What changed
Folded the Office add-in acceptance suite into `ci.yml` as a path-gated `office-addin-suite` job and retired `office-addin.yml`'s `push`/`pull_request` triggers — a PR now gets ONE workflow entry. The dispatch-only daily-publish leg still fires `office-addin.yml` directly.

### Key decisions
- New `changes` classifier output `office_addin` carries the EXACT path list the retired standalone triggers used (`office_addin/**`, `flutter_app/**`, `packages/**`, `lib/**`, `pubspec.lock`, `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`, `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml`); gated on `pull_request` + SM validation dispatches like exzone/locksmoke, and the classifier's fail-safe arm runs it rather than silently skipping.
- Job body byte-identical to the daily leg's (drift-guard test pins the two copies) — no behavior change; runner/timeout (`ubuntu-latest`, 45m, `contents: read`) unchanged.
- Wired into `quality-gate` as a PLATFORM-class leg (#1368): a red suite blocks the merge via the aggregate but never holds the pure-Dart publish; non-touching PRs skip exactly as today.
- **Check name for the ruleset update (AC3):** the check-run name is unchanged — `Office add-in suite` (branch protection / ruleset contexts that match the bare job name keep working). Only the display prefix changes: `Office add-in / office-addin-suite` → `CI / office-addin-suite`. Update the ruleset ONLY if it pinned the composite form.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart
```
Manual: a `lib/**`-only PR shows one workflow (CI) with the office-addin job inside; a `docs/**`-only PR skips it; `workflow_dispatch` on `office-addin.yml` still serves the daily addin leg.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  PR[PR touches lib / flutter_app / packages / office_addin] --> CL[ci.yml changes classifier]
  CL -->|office_addin=true| JOB[office-addin-suite job in ci.yml]
  JOB --> QG[quality-gate — platform class, single required check]
  DAILY[daily-publish addin leg] -->|workflow_dispatch| OA[office-addin.yml — dispatch only]
```

</details>

run: |
          echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      # PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set. Gated on
          # BOTH pull_request events and SM validation dispatches (the

run: |
          echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      # PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set. Gated on
          # BOTH pull_request events and SM validation dispatches (the
          # legs below consult these outputs on either event). Context:
          # the ubuntu flutter-tests leg runs this family but every
          # engine-dependent test SKIPS there (native_test_guard.dart finds
          # no QuickJS .so on a bare runner); they truly execute only on
          # macOS — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307). The issue's
          # packages/js_widget_runtime/** is an EXTERNAL repo now, so its
          # bumps arrive via the flutter_app/pubspec.yaml pin.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^flutter_app/lib/apps/|^lib/src/js_ext/|^flutter_app/test/apps/|^flutter_app/test/native_test_guard\.dart$|^flutter_app/pubspec\.yaml$)'; then
            echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2): the lockfile-refresh vector — resolution

## PR Description

Closes #1659
### What changed
Folded the Office add-in acceptance suite into `ci.yml` as a path-gated `office-addin-suite` job and retired `office-addin.yml`'s `push`/`pull_request` triggers — a PR now gets ONE workflow entry. The dispatch-only daily-publish leg still fires `office-addin.yml` directly.

### Key decisions
- New `changes` classifier output `office_addin` carries the EXACT path list the retired standalone triggers used (`office_addin/**`, `flutter_app/**`, `packages/**`, `lib/**`, `pubspec.lock`, `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`, `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml`); gated on `pull_request` + SM validation dispatches like exzone/locksmoke, and the classifier's fail-safe arm runs it rather than silently skipping.
- Job body byte-identical to the daily leg's (drift-guard test pins the two copies) — no behavior change; runner/timeout (`ubuntu-latest`, 45m, `contents: read`) unchanged.
- Wired into `quality-gate` as a PLATFORM-class leg (#1368): a red suite blocks the merge via the aggregate but never holds the pure-Dart publish; non-touching PRs skip exactly as today.
- **Check name for the ruleset update (AC3):** the check-run name is unchanged — `Office add-in suite` (branch protection / ruleset contexts that match the bare job name keep working). Only the display prefix changes: `Office add-in / office-addin-suite` → `CI / office-addin-suite`. Update the ruleset ONLY if it pinned the composite form.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart
```
Manual: a `lib/**`-only PR shows one workflow (CI) with the office-addin job inside; a `docs/**`-only PR skips it; `workflow_dispatch` on `office-addin.yml` still serves the daily addin leg.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  PR[PR touches lib / flutter_app / packages / office_addin] --> CL[ci.yml changes classifier]
  CL -->|office_addin=true| JOB[office-addin-suite job in ci.yml]
  JOB --> QG[quality-gate — platform class, single required check]
  DAILY[daily-publish addin leg] -->|workflow_dispatch| OA[office-addin.yml — dispatch only]
```

</details>

run: |
          echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      # PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set. Gated on
          # BOTH pull_request events and SM validation dispatches (the
          # legs below consult these outputs on either event). Context:
          # the ubuntu flutter-tests leg runs this family but every
          # engine-dependent test SKIPS there (native_test_guard.dart finds

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1666
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1666
- **Title**: gh-1659 [GOAL] Fold the Office add-in check into the shared CI matrix (office-addin.yml runs standalone per PR today)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1659` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +467
- **Deletions**: -33
- **Created**: 2026-10-17T08:03:10Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-17T11:06:50Z

## PR Description

Closes #1659
### What changed
Folded the Office add-in acceptance suite into `ci.yml` as a path-gated `office-addin-suite` job and retired `office-addin.yml`'s `push`/`pull_request` triggers — a PR now gets ONE workflow entry. The dispatch-only daily-publish leg still fires `office-addin.yml` directly.

### Key decisions
- New `changes` classifier output `office_addin` carries the EXACT path list the retired standalone triggers used (`office_addin/**`, `flutter_app/**`, `packages/**`, `lib/**`, `pubspec.lock`, `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`, `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml`); gated on `pull_request` + SM validation dispatches like exzone/locksmoke, and the classifier's fail-safe arm runs it rather than silently skipping.
- Job body byte-identical to the daily leg's (drift-guard test pins the two copies) — no behavior change; runner/timeout (`ubuntu-latest`, 45m, `contents: read`) unchanged.
- Wired into `quality-gate` as a PLATFORM-class leg (#1368): a red suite blocks the merge via the aggregate but never holds the pure-Dart publish; non-touching PRs skip exactly as today.
- **Check name for the ruleset update (AC3):** the check-run name is unchanged — `Office add-in suite` (branch protection / ruleset contexts that match the bare job name keep working). Only the display prefix changes: `Office add-in / office-addin-suite` → `CI / office-addin-suite`. Update the ruleset ONLY if it pinned the composite form.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart
```
Manual: a `lib/**`-only PR shows one workflow (CI) with the office-addin job inside; a `docs/**`-only PR skips it; `workflow_dispatch` on `office-addin.yml` still serves the daily addin leg.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  PR[PR touches lib / flutter_app / packages / office_addin] --> CL[ci.yml changes classifier]
  CL -->|office_addin=true| JOB[office-addin-suite job in ci.yml]
  JOB --> QG[quality-gate — platform class, single required check]
  DAILY[daily-publish addin leg] -->|workflow_dispatch| OA[office-addin.yml — dispatch only]
```

</details>

run: |
          echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      # PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |

- **PR #**: 1666
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1666
- **Title**: gh-1659 [GOAL] Fold the Office add-in check into the shared CI matrix (office-addin.yml runs standalone per PR today)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1659` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +467
- **Deletions**: -33
- **Created**: 2026-10-17T08:03:10Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-17T11:06:50Z

## PR Description

Closes #1659
### What changed
Folded the Office add-in acceptance suite into `ci.yml` as a path-gated `office-addin-suite` job and retired `office-addin.yml`'s `push`/`pull_request` triggers — a PR now gets ONE workflow entry. The dispatch-only daily-publish leg still fires `office-addin.yml` directly.

### Key decisions
- New `changes` classifier output `office_addin` carries the EXACT path list the retired standalone triggers used (`office_addin/**`, `flutter_app/**`, `packages/**`, `lib/**`, `pubspec.lock`, `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`, `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml`); gated on `pull_request` + SM validation dispatches like exzone/locksmoke, and the classifier's fail-safe arm runs it rather than silently skipping.
- Job body byte-identical to the daily leg's (drift-guard test pins the two copies) — no behavior change; runner/timeout (`ubuntu-latest`, 45m, `contents: read`) unchanged.
- Wired into `quality-gate` as a PLATFORM-class leg (#1368): a red suite blocks the merge via the aggregate but never holds the pure-Dart publish; non-touching PRs skip exactly as today.
- **Check name for the ruleset update (AC3):** the check-run name is unchanged — `Office add-in suite` (branch protection / ruleset contexts that match the bare job name keep working). Only the display prefix changes: `Office add-in / office-addin-suite` → `CI / office-addin-suite`. Update the ruleset ONLY if it pinned the composite form.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart
```
Manual: a `lib/**`-only PR shows one workflow (CI) with the office-addin job inside; a `docs/**`-only PR skips it; `workflow_dispatch` on `office-addin.yml` still serves the daily addin leg.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  PR[PR touches lib / flutter_app / packages / office_addin] --> CL[ci.yml changes classifier]
  CL -->|office_addin=true| JOB[office-addin-suite job in ci.yml]
  JOB --> QG[quality-gate — platform class, single required check]
  DAILY[daily-publish addin leg] -->|workflow_dispatch| OA[office-addin.yml — dispatch only]
```

</details>

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1659` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +467
- **Deletions**: -33
- **Created**: 2026-10-17T08:03:10Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-17T11:06:50Z

## PR Description

Closes #1659
### What changed
Folded the Office add-in acceptance suite into `ci.yml` as a path-gated `office-addin-suite` job and retired `office-addin.yml`'s `push`/`pull_request` triggers — a PR now gets ONE workflow entry. The dispatch-only daily-publish leg still fires `office-addin.yml` directly.

### Key decisions
- New `changes` classifier output `office_addin` carries the EXACT path list the retired standalone triggers used (`office_addin/**`, `flutter_app/**`, `packages/**`, `lib/**`, `pubspec.lock`, `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`, `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml`); gated on `pull_request` + SM validation dispatches like exzone/locksmoke, and the classifier's fail-safe arm runs it rather than silently skipping.
- Job body byte-identical to the daily leg's (drift-guard test pins the two copies) — no behavior change; runner/timeout (`ubuntu-latest`, 45m, `contents: read`) unchanged.
- Wired into `quality-gate` as a PLATFORM-class leg (#1368): a red suite blocks the merge via the aggregate but never holds the pure-Dart publish; non-touching PRs skip exactly as today.
- **Check name for the ruleset update (AC3):** the check-run name is unchanged — `Office add-in suite` (branch protection / ruleset contexts that match the bare job name keep working). Only the display prefix changes: `Office add-in / office-addin-suite` → `CI / office-addin-suite`. Update the ruleset ONLY if it pinned the composite form.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart
```
Manual: a `lib/**`-only PR shows one workflow (CI) with the office-addin job inside; a `docs/**`-only PR skips it; `workflow_dispatch` on `office-addin.yml` still serves the daily addin leg.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  PR[PR touches lib / flutter_app / packages / office_addin] --> CL[ci.yml changes classifier]
  CL -->|office_addin=true| JOB[office-addin-suite job in ci.yml]
  JOB --> QG[quality-gate — platform class, single required check]
  DAILY[daily-publish addin leg] -->|workflow_dispatch| OA[office-addin.yml — dispatch only]
```

</details>

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1666

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1659` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +467
- **Deletions**: -33
- **Created**: 2026-10-17T08:03:10Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-17T11:06:50Z

## PR Description

Closes #1659
### What changed
Folded the Office add-in acceptance suite into `ci.yml` as a path-gated `office-addin-suite` job and retired `office-addin.yml`'s `push`/`pull_request` triggers — a PR now gets ONE workflow entry. The dispatch-only daily-publish leg still fires `office-addin.yml` directly.

### Key decisions
- New `changes` classifier output `office_addin` carries the EXACT path list the retired standalone triggers used (`office_addin/**`, `flutter_app/**`, `packages/**`, `lib/**`, `pubspec.lock`, `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`, `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml`); gated on `pull_request` + SM validation dispatches like exzone/locksmoke, and the classifier's fail-safe arm runs it rather than silently skipping.
- Job body byte-identical to the daily leg's (drift-guard test pins the two copies) — no behavior change; runner/timeout (`ubuntu-latest`, 45m, `contents: read`) unchanged.
- Wired into `quality-gate` as a PLATFORM-class leg (#1368): a red suite blocks the merge via the aggregate but never holds the pure-Dart publish; non-touching PRs skip exactly as today.
- **Check name for the ruleset update (AC3):** the check-run name is unchanged — `Office add-in suite` (branch protection / ruleset contexts that match the bare job name keep working). Only the display prefix changes: `Office add-in / office-addin-suite` → `CI / office-addin-suite`. Update the ruleset ONLY if it pinned the composite form.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart
```
Manual: a `lib/**`-only PR shows one workflow (CI) with the office-addin job inside; a `docs/**`-only PR skips it; `workflow_dispatch` on `office-addin.yml` still serves the daily addin leg.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  PR[PR touches lib / flutter_app / packages / office_addin] --> CL[ci.yml changes classifier]
  CL -->|office_addin=true| JOB[office-addin-suite job in ci.yml]
  JOB --> QG[quality-gate — platform class, single required check]
  DAILY[daily-publish addin leg] -->|workflow_dispatch| OA[office-addin.yml — dispatch only]
```

</details>

# pr-1666: gh-1659 [GOAL] Fold the Office add-in check into the shared CI matrix (office-addin.yml runs standalone per PR today)

## Description

Closes #1659
### What changed
Folded the Office add-in acceptance suite into `ci.yml` as a path-gated `office-addin-suite` job and retired `office-addin.yml`'s `push`/`pull_request` triggers — a PR now gets ONE workflow entry. The dispatch-only daily-publish leg still fires `office-addin.yml` directly.

### Key decisions
- New `changes` classifier output `office_addin` carries the EXACT path list the retired standalone triggers used (`office_addin/**`, `flutter_app/**`, `packages/**`, `lib/**`, `pubspec.lock`, `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`, `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml`); gated on `pull_request` + SM validation dispatches like exzone/locksmoke, and the classifier's fail-safe arm runs it rather than silently skipping.
- Job body byte-identical to the daily leg's (drift-guard test pins the two copies) — no behavior change; runner/timeout (`ubuntu-latest`, 45m, `contents: read`) unchanged.
- Wired into `quality-gate` as a PLATFORM-class leg (#1368): a red suite blocks the merge via the aggregate but never holds the pure-Dart publish; non-touching PRs skip exactly as today.
- **Check name for the ruleset update (AC3):** the check-run name is unchanged — `Office add-in suite` (branch protection / ruleset contexts that match the bare job name keep working). Only the display prefix changes: `Office add-in / office-addin-suite` → `CI / office-addin-suite`. Update the ruleset ONLY if it pinned the composite form.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart
```
Manual: a `lib/**`-only PR shows one workflow (CI) with the office-addin job inside; a `docs/**`-only PR skips it; `workflow_dispatch` on `office-addin.yml` still serves the daily addin leg.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  PR[PR touches lib / flutter_app / packages / office_addin] --> CL[ci.yml changes classifier]
  CL -->|office_addin=true| JOB[office-addin-suite job in ci.yml]
  JOB --> QG[quality-gate — platform class, single required check]
  DAILY[daily-publish addin leg] -->|workflow_dispatch| OA[office-addin.yml — dispatch only]
```

</details>

# Rework — gh-1659 office-addin matrix fold

## Issues/Notes

- **Review thread (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) — stale fail-safe warning (FIXED):** the
  classifier's fail-safe arm now fires four outputs (`exzone`, `locksmoke`, `installer`,
  `office_addin`) but the `::warning::` line still read `failing safe: exzone + locksmoke
  arms run`. Updated the warning to
  `failing safe: exzone + locksmoke + installer + office_addin arms run` so an
  incident investigator sees the true leg set.
- **Test pins (FIXED):** both pins that locked the stale wording in were updated —
  `test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart` (the gh-1659 pin called out in the
  thread) **and** `test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart` (same stale pin from the
  gh-1267 suite — the same-pattern sweep, so the inaccuracy can't re-enter via the
  older test). Each pin now also carries a reason comment stating the warning must
  name every output the arm fires.
- **PR-description nit (from the APPROVE review, not code-fixable here):** the
  description's display-name arrow `Office add-in / office-addin-suite` →
  `CI / office-addin-suite` is cosmetic but wrong — the check display uses the job
  `name:`, so it renders as **`CI / Office add-in suite`**. Description edit is left to
  the owner/dispatch path; the ruleset guidance is unchanged (bare name
  `Office add-in suite` is preserved, so rulesets pinning it keep working).
- The three remaining open "threads" in the discussion export carry no
  `threadId`/`rootCommentId`: the APPROVE verdict body (its two suggestions are the
  items above), a `dmtools:review-verdict` machine record ("do not edit or reply"),
  and a `dmtools:rework-consume` audit notice. No targeted reply is possible for
  those; they are addressed via this top-level comment.

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN):

1. **RED** — updated both test pins to expect the four-arm wording; the two tests
   failed against the unmodified workflow (2 failed / 25 passed), reproducing the
   reported staleness.
2. **GREEN** — changed the single `::warning::` line in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
   (classifier fail-safe arm, `changes` job `paths` step). No other workflow logic
   touched; the four `echo … >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"` lines are unchanged.
3. **Sweep** — `grep -rn "failing safe"` across the repo: no other production copy of
   the stale text exists.

## Files Modified

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — fail-safe warning text now names all four arms.
- `test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart` — pin updated + reason comment.
- `test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart` — same stale pin updated + reason.

## Test Coverage

```bash
dart test test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart \
        test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart \
        test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart \
        test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart
```

- RED run (before the workflow fix): 25 passed, **2 failed** — the two updated pins,
  reproducing the issue.
- GREEN run (after the fix): **57 tests passed** (all four suites, incl. the
  gh-1659 drift-guard deep-comparing the two office-addin job bodies and the
  gh-1267 fail-safe / dispatch-arm tests).

Fixed in this rework pass.

The classifier fail-safe warning in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` now reads:

```bash
echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke + installer + office_addin arms run"
```

so it names all four outputs the arm fires (`exzone`, `locksmoke`, `installer`, `office_addin`) — the log now tells an incident investigator the truth about which legs will run.

- `test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart` — the same stale pin in the gh-1267 suite (same-pattern sweep, so the old text can't re-enter through the older test).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1666
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1666
- **Title**: gh-1659 [GOAL] Fold the Office add-in check into the shared CI matrix (office-addin.yml runs standalone per PR today)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1659` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +467
- **Deletions**: -33
- **Created**: 2026-10-17T08:03:10Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-17T11:06:50Z

## PR Description

Closes #1659
### What changed
Folded the Office add-in acceptance suite into `ci.yml` as a path-gated `office-addin-suite` job and retired `office-addin.yml`'s `push`/`pull_request` triggers — a PR now gets ONE workflow entry. The dispatch-only daily-publish leg still fires `office-addin.yml` directly.

### Key decisions
- New `changes` classifier output `office_addin` carries the EXACT path list the retired standalone triggers used (`office_addin/**`, `flutter_app/**`, `packages/**`, `lib/**`, `pubspec.lock`, `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`, `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml`); gated on `pull_request` + SM validation dispatches like exzone/locksmoke, and the classifier's fail-safe arm runs it rather than silently skipping.
- Job body byte-identical to the daily leg's (drift-guard test pins the two copies) — no behavior change; runner/timeout (`ubuntu-latest`, 45m, `contents: read`) unchanged.
- Wired into `quality-gate` as a PLATFORM-class leg (#1368): a red suite blocks the merge via the aggregate but never holds the pure-Dart publish; non-touching PRs skip exactly as today.
- **Check name for the ruleset update (AC3):** the check-run name is unchanged — `Office add-in suite` (branch protection / ruleset contexts that match the bare job name keep working). Only the display prefix changes: `Office add-in / office-addin-suite` → `CI / office-addin-suite`. Update the ruleset ONLY if it pinned the composite form.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart
```
Manual: a `lib/**`-only PR shows one workflow (CI) with the office-addin job inside; a `docs/**`-only PR skips it; `workflow_dispatch` on `office-addin.yml` still serves the daily addin leg.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  PR[PR touches lib / flutter_app / packages / office_addin] --> CL[ci.yml changes classifier]
  CL -->|office_addin=true| JOB[office-addin-suite job in ci.yml]
  JOB --> QG[quality-gate — platform class, single required check]
  DAILY[daily-publish addin leg] -->|workflow_dispatch| OA[office-addin.yml — dispatch only]
```

</details>

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1666
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1666
- **Title**: gh-1659 [GOAL] Fold the Office add-in check into the shared CI matrix (office-addin.yml runs standalone per PR today)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1659` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +467
- **Deletions**: -33
- **Created**: 2026-10-17T08:03:10Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-17T11:06:50Z

## PR Description

Closes #1659
### What changed
Folded the Office add-in acceptance suite into `ci.yml` as a path-gated `office-addin-suite` job and retired `office-addin.yml`'s `push`/`pull_request` triggers — a PR now gets ONE workflow entry. The dispatch-only daily-publish leg still fires `office-addin.yml` directly.

### Key decisions
- New `changes` classifier output `office_addin` carries the EXACT path list the retired standalone triggers used (`office_addin/**`, `flutter_app/**`, `packages/**`, `lib/**`, `pubspec.lock`, `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`, `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml`); gated on `pull_request` + SM validation dispatches like exzone/locksmoke, and the classifier's fail-safe arm runs it rather than silently skipping.
- Job body byte-identical to the daily leg's (drift-guard test pins the two copies) — no behavior change; runner/timeout (`ubuntu-latest`, 45m, `contents: read`) unchanged.
- Wired into `quality-gate` as a PLATFORM-class leg (#1368): a red suite blocks the merge via the aggregate but never holds the pure-Dart publish; non-touching PRs skip exactly as today.
- **Check name for the ruleset update (AC3):** the check-run name is unchanged — `Office add-in suite` (branch protection / ruleset contexts that match the bare job name keep working). Only the display prefix changes: `Office add-in / office-addin-suite` → `CI / office-addin-suite`. Update the ruleset ONLY if it pinned the composite form.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart
```
Manual: a `lib/**`-only PR shows one workflow (CI) with the office-addin job inside; a `docs/**`-only PR skips it; `workflow_dispatch` on `office-addin.yml` still serves the daily addin leg.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  PR[PR touches lib / flutter_app / packages / office_addin] --> CL[ci.yml changes classifier]
  CL -->|office_addin=true| JOB[office-addin-suite job in ci.yml]
  JOB --> QG[quality-gate — platform class, single required check]
  DAILY[daily-publish addin leg] -->|workflow_dispatch| OA[office-addin.yml — dispatch only]
```

</details>

# pr-1666: gh-1659 [GOAL] Fold the Office add-in check into the shared CI matrix (office-addin.yml runs standalone per PR today)

## Description

Closes #1659
### What changed
Folded the Office add-in acceptance suite into `ci.yml` as a path-gated `office-addin-suite` job and retired `office-addin.yml`'s `push`/`pull_request` triggers — a PR now gets ONE workflow entry. The dispatch-only daily-publish leg still fires `office-addin.yml` directly.

### Key decisions
- New `changes` classifier output `office_addin` carries the EXACT path list the retired standalone triggers used (`office_addin/**`, `flutter_app/**`, `packages/**`, `lib/**`, `pubspec.lock`, `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`, `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml`); gated on `pull_request` + SM validation dispatches like exzone/locksmoke, and the classifier's fail-safe arm runs it rather than silently skipping.
- Job body byte-identical to the daily leg's (drift-guard test pins the two copies) — no behavior change; runner/timeout (`ubuntu-latest`, 45m, `contents: read`) unchanged.
- Wired into `quality-gate` as a PLATFORM-class leg (#1368): a red suite blocks the merge via the aggregate but never holds the pure-Dart publish; non-touching PRs skip exactly as today.
- **Check name for the ruleset update (AC3):** the check-run name is unchanged — `Office add-in suite` (branch protection / ruleset contexts that match the bare job name keep working). Only the display prefix changes: `Office add-in / office-addin-suite` → `CI / office-addin-suite`. Update the ruleset ONLY if it pinned the composite form.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart
```
Manual: a `lib/**`-only PR shows one workflow (CI) with the office-addin job inside; a `docs/**`-only PR skips it; `workflow_dispatch` on `office-addin.yml` still serves the daily addin leg.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  PR[PR touches lib / flutter_app / packages / office_addin] --> CL[ci.yml changes classifier]
  CL -->|office_addin=true| JOB[office-addin-suite job in ci.yml]
  JOB --> QG[quality-gate — platform class, single required check]
  DAILY[daily-publish addin leg] -->|workflow_dispatch| OA[office-addin.yml — dispatch only]
```

</details>

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1666
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1666
- **Title**: gh-1659 [GOAL] Fold the Office add-in check into the shared CI matrix (office-addin.yml runs standalone per PR today)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1659` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +467
- **Deletions**: -33
- **Created**: 2026-10-17T08:03:10Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-17T11:06:50Z

## PR Description

Closes #1659
### What changed
Folded the Office add-in acceptance suite into `ci.yml` as a path-gated `office-addin-suite` job and retired `office-addin.yml`'s `push`/`pull_request` triggers — a PR now gets ONE workflow entry. The dispatch-only daily-publish leg still fires `office-addin.yml` directly.

### Key decisions
- New `changes` classifier output `office_addin` carries the EXACT path list the retired standalone triggers used (`office_addin/**`, `flutter_app/**`, `packages/**`, `lib/**`, `pubspec.lock`, `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`, `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml`); gated on `pull_request` + SM validation dispatches like exzone/locksmoke, and the classifier's fail-safe arm runs it rather than silently skipping.
- Job body byte-identical to the daily leg's (drift-guard test pins the two copies) — no behavior change; runner/timeout (`ubuntu-latest`, 45m, `contents: read`) unchanged.
- Wired into `quality-gate` as a PLATFORM-class leg (#1368): a red suite blocks the merge via the aggregate but never holds the pure-Dart publish; non-touching PRs skip exactly as today.
- **Check name for the ruleset update (AC3):** the check-run name is unchanged — `Office add-in suite` (branch protection / ruleset contexts that match the bare job name keep working). Only the display prefix changes: `Office add-in / office-addin-suite` → `CI / office-addin-suite`. Update the ruleset ONLY if it pinned the composite form.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart
```
Manual: a `lib/**`-only PR shows one workflow (CI) with the office-addin job inside; a `docs/**`-only PR skips it; `workflow_dispatch` on `office-addin.yml` still serves the daily addin leg.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  PR[PR touches lib / flutter_app / packages / office_addin] --> CL[ci.yml changes classifier]
  CL -->|office_addin=true| JOB[office-addin-suite job in ci.yml]
  JOB --> QG[quality-gate — platform class, single required check]
  DAILY[daily-publish addin leg] -->|workflow_dispatch| OA[office-addin.yml — dispatch only]
```

</details>

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1666
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1666
- **Title**: gh-1659 [GOAL] Fold the Office add-in check into the shared CI matrix (office-addin.yml runs standalone per PR today)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1659` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +467
- **Deletions**: -33
- **Created**: 2026-10-17T08:03:10Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-17T11:06:50Z

## PR Description

Closes #1659
### What changed
Folded the Office add-in acceptance suite into `ci.yml` as a path-gated `office-addin-suite` job and retired `office-addin.yml`'s `push`/`pull_request` triggers — a PR now gets ONE workflow entry. The dispatch-only daily-publish leg still fires `office-addin.yml` directly.

### Key decisions
- New `changes` classifier output `office_addin` carries the EXACT path list the retired standalone triggers used (`office_addin/**`, `flutter_app/**`, `packages/**`, `lib/**`, `pubspec.lock`, `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`, `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml`); gated on `pull_request` + SM validation dispatches like exzone/locksmoke, and the classifier's fail-safe arm runs it rather than silently skipping.
- Job body byte-identical to the daily leg's (drift-guard test pins the two copies) — no behavior change; runner/timeout (`ubuntu-latest`, 45m, `contents: read`) unchanged.
- Wired into `quality-gate` as a PLATFORM-class leg (#1368): a red suite blocks the merge via the aggregate but never holds the pure-Dart publish; non-touching PRs skip exactly as today.
- **Check name for the ruleset update (AC3):** the check-run name is unchanged — `Office add-in suite` (branch protection / ruleset contexts that match the bare job name keep working). Only the display prefix changes: `Office add-in / office-addin-suite` → `CI / office-addin-suite`. Update the ruleset ONLY if it pinned the composite form.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart
```
Manual: a `lib/**`-only PR shows one workflow (CI) with the office-addin job inside; a `docs/**`-only PR skips it; `workflow_dispatch` on `office-addin.yml` still serves the daily addin leg.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  PR[PR touches lib / flutter_app / packages / office_addin] --> CL[ci.yml changes classifier]
  CL -->|office_addin=true| JOB[office-addin-suite job in ci.yml]
  JOB --> QG[quality-gate — platform class, single required check]
  DAILY[daily-publish addin leg] -->|workflow_dispatch| OA[office-addin.yml — dispatch only]
```

</details>

run: |
          echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      # PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set. Gated on
          # BOTH pull_request events and SM validation dispatches (the

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1666
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1666
- **Title**: gh-1659 [GOAL] Fold the Office add-in check into the shared CI matrix (office-addin.yml runs standalone per PR today)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1659` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +467
- **Deletions**: -33
- **Created**: 2026-10-17T08:03:10Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-17T11:06:50Z

## PR Description

Closes #1659
### What changed
Folded the Office add-in acceptance suite into `ci.yml` as a path-gated `office-addin-suite` job and retired `office-addin.yml`'s `push`/`pull_request` triggers — a PR now gets ONE workflow entry. The dispatch-only daily-publish leg still fires `office-addin.yml` directly.

### Key decisions
- New `changes` classifier output `office_addin` carries the EXACT path list the retired standalone triggers used (`office_addin/**`, `flutter_app/**`, `packages/**`, `lib/**`, `pubspec.lock`, `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`, `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml`); gated on `pull_request` + SM validation dispatches like exzone/locksmoke, and the classifier's fail-safe arm runs it rather than silently skipping.
- Job body byte-identical to the daily leg's (drift-guard test pins the two copies) — no behavior change; runner/timeout (`ubuntu-latest`, 45m, `contents: read`) unchanged.
- Wired into `quality-gate` as a PLATFORM-class leg (#1368): a red suite blocks the merge via the aggregate but never holds the pure-Dart publish; non-touching PRs skip exactly as today.
- **Check name for the ruleset update (AC3):** the check-run name is unchanged — `Office add-in suite` (branch protection / ruleset contexts that match the bare job name keep working). Only the display prefix changes: `Office add-in / office-addin-suite` → `CI / office-addin-suite`. Update the ruleset ONLY if it pinned the composite form.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart
```
Manual: a `lib/**`-only PR shows one workflow (CI) with the office-addin job inside; a `docs/**`-only PR skips it; `workflow_dispatch` on `office-addin.yml` still serves the daily addin leg.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  PR[PR touches lib / flutter_app / packages / office_addin] --> CL[ci.yml changes classifier]
  CL -->|office_addin=true| JOB[office-addin-suite job in ci.yml]
  JOB --> QG[quality-gate — platform class, single required check]
  DAILY[daily-publish addin leg] -->|workflow_dispatch| OA[office-addin.yml — dispatch only]
```

</details>

# pr-1666: gh-1659 [GOAL] Fold the Office add-in check into the shared CI matrix (office-addin.yml runs standalone per PR today)

## Description

Closes #1659
### What changed
Folded the Office add-in acceptance suite into `ci.yml` as a path-gated `office-addin-suite` job and retired `office-addin.yml`'s `push`/`pull_request` triggers — a PR now gets ONE workflow entry. The dispatch-only daily-publish leg still fires `office-addin.yml` directly.

### Key decisions
- New `changes` classifier output `office_addin` carries the EXACT path list the retired standalone triggers used (`office_addin/**`, `flutter_app/**`, `packages/**`, `lib/**`, `pubspec.lock`, `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`, `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml`); gated on `pull_request` + SM validation dispatches like exzone/locksmoke, and the classifier's fail-safe arm runs it rather than silently skipping.
- Job body byte-identical to the daily leg's (drift-guard test pins the two copies) — no behavior change; runner/timeout (`ubuntu-latest`, 45m, `contents: read`) unchanged.
- Wired into `quality-gate` as a PLATFORM-class leg (#1368): a red suite blocks the merge via the aggregate but never holds the pure-Dart publish; non-touching PRs skip exactly as today.
- **Check name for the ruleset update (AC3):** the check-run name is unchanged — `Office add-in suite` (branch protection / ruleset contexts that match the bare job name keep working). Only the display prefix changes: `Office add-in / office-addin-suite` → `CI / office-addin-suite`. Update the ruleset ONLY if it pinned the composite form.

dart test test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart

flowchart TD

  JOB --> QG[quality-gate — platform class, single required check]
